'BReview.mask_integrable' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'BReview.finite_shell_contraction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'BReview.shell_reconstruction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
BReview.shell_reconstruction.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X) [Countable E]
  (p : E → X → ℝ) (hp : ∀ (e : E), Measurable (p e)) (hp0 : ∀ (e : E) (x : X), 0 ≤ p e x)
  (hpart : ∀ (x : X), HasSum (fun e => p e x) 1) (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f mu) :
  HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p e x) * f x ∂mu) (∫ (x : X), f x ∂mu)
